criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.note: Opens with named date (June 7), 403 proposals, $272M, hard deadline June 22, then 'The hard question isn’t whether the AI works.' Stands alone past the see-more cutoff; capital consequence implied rather than stated, one notch below 10.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.note: All three stories carry a sharp AK anchor plus a named industry consequence (RHTP $272M/five-year gate/vendor revenue risk; AI EO named classes + July 2 CISA clock; RFLP AFCEC-26-R-0006, three bases, GVEA grid risk).

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.note: Named specifics in nearly every sentence: 403, $272M, June 22, mid-July, Mina verbatim, Providence 8, TCC drone, five-year minimum, June 5 EO, CISA ~July 2, AFCEC-26-R-0006, JBER/Eielson/Clear, June 29, June 8-9 pushback.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.note: Every claim maps to verified_findings.json. RHTP: DOH primary + 3 outlets. EO: White House primary. RFLP: HigherGov primary + KTUU. '27 villages' correctly stripped.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.note: Direct continuation of post_001 voice. Analytical, names the real constraint ('It isn’t capital and it isn’t the technology'), structural close, no hype or influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.note: 414 words, 2654 chars. Paragraphs 1-4 sentences. Bullet block 3 single-clause items. Scans on desktop and mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.note: Real, debatable, names four stakeholder options tied to the five-year sustainability gate. No softener, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.note: Concrete this-week triggers: June 22 RHTP applications, June 29 RFLP bids, ~July 2 CISA window, plus a reusable five-year sustainability risk frame for underwriting AI grants.

one_sentence_fix: To push hook strength from 9 to 10, append one explicit phrase naming the vendor recurring-revenue risk to the opening, e.g. 'and who captures the recurring revenue after.'
